purpose_context: Spec Kitty has no direct channel for hearing how people experience missions and ad-hoc work. A short, optional two-question Feedback Survey (a 1-5 rating plus 'what would you change?') shown at natural completion points gives maintainers a steady signal, while staying anonymous by default, sending only with explicit consent each time, and never blocking the user's workflow.
purpose_tldr: Let Spec Kitty users rate their experience and suggest changes at key moments, without getting in their way.
